Titles.jpn: 劇場版 HUNTER×HUNTER 緋色の幻影（ファントム・ルージュ）

Summaries.eng: Someone has stolen Kurapika’s eyes—and according to him, it’s another survivor from his clan whose members were massacred for their Scarlet Eyes! Gon and Killua begin investigating on his behalf, but shortly after they’ve begun, the Phantom Troupe appears!

Aliases: Gekijouban Hunter x Hunter: Phantom Rouge
